hooks.name: Update Session Summary
hooks.description: After each agent session ends, append a session entry to docs/SESSION-SUMMARY.md with what was accomplished, estimated tokens/credits, time spent, and files modified.

action.prompt: Append a new session entry to docs/SESSION-SUMMARY.md. Include: date, what was accomplished in this session, estimated token usage (input/output), estimated cost, approximate time spent, and a list of files created or modified. Keep the format consistent with existing entries in the file.
